name: Paul Rodriguez x Nike SB Air Zoom Low 'Dodgers'
story_html: The Paul Rodriguez x Nike SB Air Zoom Low 'Dodgers' dresses the retro skate shoe in a color palette inspired by LA's MLB franchise. P-Rod's debut signature model features a two-tone suede upper in Flint Grey and Medium Grey. The perforated Swoosh is rendered in Deep Royal Blue, matching the textile collar lining and the Nike SB logo that graces the tongue tag. Anchoring the sneaker is a rubber cupsole with exposed Zoom Air cushioning in the heel.
details: Flint Grey/Deep Royal Blue-Flint Grey-Medium Grey-White
